# Dima Laundry

> Dima Laundry LLC is a Dubai laundry and dry cleaning company operating since 2001, with branches across Dubai and its own cleaning facilities in Al Quoz. It serves households and businesses with free pickup and delivery. Phone 800 DIMA (3462).

Mobile app: iOS https://apps.apple.com/ae/app/dima-laundry-dry-cleaning/id6738209489 | Android https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.cleancloudapp.dimalaundry
